scope: Independent stdlib-only recomputation from literal input pack and raw rank readouts; existing analysis/helper not loaded or imported. No model call, GPU, loss, update, threshold or production change.

paired_layout_contract.input_order: reference,factual per sample, from exact original trace_token_attribution helper; full original pair/mask and all 84 observed forward-ID hashes independently reproduced using little-endian int64 bytes
paired_layout_contract.factual_rows: Literal selected rows unchanged for all variants; actual native prefix and paired suffix hashes prove values/order
paired_layout_contract.single_reference_rows: In each single variant, every source_step=0 row becomes factual except its own one sampled token replaced by EOS; other first-response references in the same B4 also each change one token. Non-first-response partner references retain original full-response EOS. No claim of a one-target-row-only batch intervention.
paired_layout_contract.prefix: Each single variant is deliberately fixed to its baseline full-EOS observed cut and invokes original numeric MIN callback; not single deletion natural maximal prefix. Original owner cache/forward path retained.
paired_layout_contract.predictor: prompt_length−1−observed_prefix_length; positions repeated twice for ref/fact; labels=16, outcomes=[15,16]; all 42 maps exact.
paired_layout_contract.source: input_position=source_start+source_position, inside [source_start,source_end); original token ID verified in literal row; all52 exact.
paired_layout_contract.saved_d: d=−log1p(−A/Q), Q=g=1; exact match for all52 saved pack d values. This is reconstructed from original saved FP32 A, not original FP64 signed entries.
paired_layout_contract.score_check: Original FP32 owner score is observed. Optional descriptive stdlib binary-softmax reread of raw FP32 logits only checks label direction; it does not replace original score.

coverage.duplicate_handling: Each unique token uses arithmetic mean of repeated native d; saved DT d/A/Q/V are exactly equal within duplicate keys. Also report first occurrence and all observations to show duplicate handling effect.
coverage.scope_limit: Only two preselected fixed-random first-response token positions per successful trajectory; not all32,253 successful action tokens, not full64 return0 task behavior. Random-position provenance is bound to original case-pack source receipt; this local review does not reopen remote DataProto carriers.

baseline_full_EOS_vs_original_endpoints.meaning: Descriptive reproduction errors under the original paired layout, without any official full-model numerical pass threshold.

interpretation.supported: Under the verified original B4 interleaved native path and fixed baseline prefix cut, saved joint-full-response DT per-token estimates differ materially in size and signs from actual native single-token EOS effects at these42 random positions. Literal-ID, ref/fact, predictor-shift and source-position errors were not found in this matched diagnostic. Baseline endpoint reproduction and duplicate differences are much smaller than observed token effect discrepancies, descriptively. This is evidence about native DT finite-decomposition approximation quality.
not_proven: Native single deletion is not a real-world oracle or full environment counterfactual.
No official whole-model numerical tolerance or acceptance gate is introduced.
This sample does not establish error distribution over the full successful token batch, the43 G0 trajectories, or all historical bad updates.
It does not determine which internal DT layer/rule creates the estimate gap.
It does not alone prove causal responsibility for the smooth historical training collapse or justify changing fixed Q/V/A, PPO or coefficients.
